title: Chanson du Muletier
identity: Robert Planel's Suite Romantique no. 6, Chanson du Muletier, is an alto saxophone and piano piece published by Leduc (AL20251).

evidence.claim: The opened library catalog identifies Suite romantique as six pieces for alto saxophone and piano, Leduc, 1944.
A retailer record identifies no. 6, Chanson du Muletier, for alto saxophone and piano.

The Philharmonie de Paris ten-year saxophone guide describes no. 6, Chanson du Muletier, as fairly animated in 2/4, quarter note = 126, with three sharps; listed duration 3:15. This is a guide description, not direct score inspection.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, Dix ans avec le saxophone

review_focus: The guide reports an animated 2/4 pulse at quarter note = 126. Inspect the score for articulation and rhythmic execution; no notation was inspected.
collection_flag: One of six original alto saxophone/piano pieces, from 1944; no simplification is established.
gaps: No score pages or saxophone performance were inspected.
The exact target copy and college/professional use were not verified.
